Project $2,500,000.00, model $0.00 ("Worksheet 1: smaller of cost 0.00 or 2,500,000 = 0.00"). The model followed Worksheet 1, whose line 3 takes the smaller of the cost of 2025 section 179 property and $2,500,000; that is the alternative reading recorded in amb.2025.s179_carryover_no_property, and the owner adopted line 1 as the $2,500,000 the line 1 instruction states (TASKS T-043; ambiguities/research/amb.2025.s179_carryover_no_property.md).
